items.title: Israel and Hezbollah continue strikes despite ceasefire agreement
items.description: Several people are reported killed in southern Lebanon, with the IDF saying it hit "Hezbollah terrorist targets" after the group fired over 50 projectiles at Israeli forces.

items.title: Zelensky stripped of highest Polish honour over WW2 name of army unit
items.description: Ukraine has denounced the move, calling it a "strategic mistake" and "disrespectful".

items.title: Tourist dies in Dominican Republic luxury resort fire
items.description: Nearly 1,700 people were evacuated from the huge blaze at Viva Wyndham Dominicus Beach in Bayahibe, a popular resort town on the Caribbean coast.

items.title: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
items.description: The highly public exchange is an indication that their earlier close ties have frayed  since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.

items.title: US to stop funding HIV programmes in South Africa
items.description: More than eight million South Africans are living with HIV – the highest number of any country in the world.

items.title: Watch: World Cup fans react to US defeating Australia to reach knockout round
items.description: US supporters were delighted after their team won 2-0 against the Socceroos while Australian fans were left disappointed but still hopeful.

items.title: Australia confirms first case of H5N1 bird flu as virus reaches every continent
items.description: Australia was previously the only continent where the H5N1 bird flu strain had not yet been found.
